Livingston is a thriving area with strong demand for reliable full bathroom installation and fitting services. Local properties range from period Victorian and Edwardian homes through to modern new-build developments, each presenting different plumbing requirements and challenges.

Our Gas Safe registered engineers serve all areas of Livingston and the surrounding West Lothian region. Whether you're in the town centre or the surrounding residential areas, we provide prompt, professional bathroom installation services with transparent pricing and no hidden call-out charges.

With years of experience working across West Lothian, our engineers understand the specific plumbing challenges faced by local homeowners. From the older pipe infrastructure common in period properties to the modern systems found in newer developments, our team has the expertise to handle any full bathroom installation and fitting requirement.

We cover all postcodes across Livingston with same-day availability for urgent work. All our engineers are fully qualified, insured, and committed to leaving your property clean and tidy after every job.

faqs.q: Can you move the toilet and bath to different positions?
faqs.a: Yes, but it depends on the soil pipe route and floor structure. Moving a toilet more than a metre from the existing soil stack requires a new soil pipe connection and increases cost significantly.

faqs.q: How much does a bathroom installation cost?
faqs.a: Labour for a full bathroom installation typically ranges from £2,500 to £5,000 depending on complexity. Suite and tile costs are separate. A complete bathroom renovation including all materials typically costs £4,000 to £10,000+.

faqs.q: Should I supply my own bathroom suite or let the plumber supply it?
faqs.a: You can do either. Supplying your own suite gives you more choice and control over the brand and style. Your installer may offer trade discounts worth 15-30% off RRP if they supply.

faqs.q: What guarantees should I expect on a bathroom installation?
faqs.a: Expect a minimum 12-month labour guarantee. Manufacturer warranties on suites and fittings typically run 5-25 years depending on the brand. Get all guarantees in writing.

localParagraph: Bathroom installation work in Livingston draws on a genuinely varied housing landscape, from the post-war semis around Dedridge and the flatted properties near Craigswood to the newer executive builds spreading out towards Deans and Murieston. Contractors working on Almondvale Road or across the Ladywell estate regularly encounter a mix of older cast-iron waste systems alongside more recent plastic plumbing, which means no two jobs are quite the same. West Lothian's water sits at a moderate hardness level, roughly in the 100 to 150 milligrams per litre range, which is softer than much of central Scotland but still worth accounting for when specifying taps, shower valves and water-fed appliances. Limescale builds gradually rather than aggressively, so ceramic disc cartridges tend to hold up reasonably well without additional filtration, though Combination boiler-fed showers in the tighter bathrooms typical of Howden or Knightsridge benefit from a scale reducer fitted at the inlet. Material choices, tile adhesive curing times and sealant performance all shift depending on whether the job is a 1970s system-built house or a mid-2000s private development.
whatItInvolves: A full bathroom installation covers everything from stripping out the existing suite to fitting the new one — including all pipework, waste connections, tiling preparation, flooring, and electrical work for lighting and extraction. A quality bathroom installation transforms one of the most-used rooms in your home and typically adds 3-5% to your property value.
process: The process starts with a detailed survey to assess existing pipework, drainage routes, and structural considerations. Day 1-2: strip out and prep. Day 3-4: first fix plumbing and any structural work. Day 5-7: suite installation, tiling, and second fix. Day 8-10: finishing, sealant, and final inspection. You'll be without a working bathroom for 5-10 days depending on complexity — we'll agree a realistic timeline upfront.
whatToExpect: Expect a detailed written quote covering labour, waste disposal, and any structural work. Suite and tiles are usually supplied separately by you or sourced through us. All plumbing work is carried out to Water Regulations standards. A bathroom installation is a major investment — ask to see previous work and Gas Safe registration before committing to any installer.
